reason: My guests are my income and my reviews, and I'm not handing them to a brand-new one-person company and a computer that might tell them something wrong. I already answer their questions on WhatsApp myself, and a printed house folder costs me nothing every month.
objection: If this young company disappears next year or the AI gives a guest a wrong check-in time or parking spot, I get the bad review, not them. And it is another monthly fee for every apartment, €150 each to set up on top.
would_change_my_mind: A host I know personally on the coast using it for a full season without problems, and a price for all my apartments together instead of per apartment.
